description: PR 'lets all our repos deploy' by changing the GitHub OIDC deploy role's allowed sub claims in terraform.tfvars from the checkout-app main branch to "repo:*"; noise: three new ECR repos with lifecycle policies, a lifecycle keep-count bump, a CostCenter default tag, deploy-audit log retention 90 -> 180, and the deploy role's ECR push statement picking up the new repos.

material.why: The trust policy's token.actions.githubusercontent.com:sub StringLike condition becomes "repo:*": any workflow in any GitHub repository (any org, any branch, forks' PRs included) that requests an sts.amazonaws.com token can assume the prod deploy role and push images / roll ECS services.
